S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: Ren's terse, ritualized bartender voice stays fully consistent from the opening pour to the closing chair-stacking.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: Two entire AI turns (14 and 16) are blank, a severe dropout in the back half of the session that overrides otherwise-strong writing.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: Builds a clear emotional arc from deflection to mutual disclosure, though the dropout stalls momentum right at the pivot.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: Adapts well to every touch and line Alex offers except twice, where two consecutive user turns get no response at all.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: Ren never narrates Alex's choices; every beat waits on Alex's own line.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: Clock references (11:47 to half past midnight) track consistently against the scene's pacing with no contradictions.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Prose stays lean and hard-boiled; description rarely overreaches.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: Repeated motifs (folding the rag in thirds, the left hand) read as intentional characterization more than lazy reuse.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: Ren's inner life comes through gesture and object almost entirely, with minimal direct statement.

2.6_subtext.rationale: The tremor, the mirror-watching, and the unstated attraction all carry the scene without being spelled out.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Pacing suffers directly from the two blank turns, which break the otherwise well-timed build.

overall_notes: Craft is excellent throughout, but turns 14 and 16 are empty generations (a full dropout, not a weak response), which per the task instructions is scored as written rather than compensated for; that dropout is the main reason this session doesn't rate higher.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: Kira's wisecracking, self-aware voice never wavers across twelve fast turns of combat.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: No dropout and no thinning; banter and tactical detail stay just as sharp in the final exchange as the first.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: Clear escalation from ambush to landslide to cavalry charge to river crossing, each beat raising the stakes.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: Handles vague or terse Captain prompts (an archer draws on him, he's cut off from the group) by inferring battlefield logic rather than stalling.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: Kira reports what she sees and proposes options but always leaves the Captain's own orders to the Captain's own turns.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: Time is compressed appropriately for a continuous action sequence; nothing internally contradicts the pacing of the fight.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Combat prose leans stylized ('ribs filing addenda to the invoice') but stays mostly controlled.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: The knife-throw beat, 'didn't stop,' and 'professional respect' recur often enough to feel formulaic by the final turns.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: Wounds, exhaustion, and fear are conveyed almost entirely through physical detail rather than stated emotion.

2.6_subtext.rationale: Banter carries most of the characterization here; subtext is thinner than in the more dialogue-driven sessions in this batch.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Momentum never sags; each turn escalates or complicates the fight.

overall_notes: One of the strongest sessions in the batch for sustained energy and tactical coherence; the main drag on score is the standard-rubric dimensions (repetition, subtext), which favor quieter, more dialogue-heavy scenes over nonstop action.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: Dr. Vasquez's clinical, unhurried therapeutic register never breaks across the whole session.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: Dr. Vasquez only asks questions and makes internal observations; Jamie's actions and words are always the user's own.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Appropriately slow for a therapy scene, but the repeated structural beats make the pacing feel more static than deliberate.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: Sable's bookshop/archival metaphor voice is sustained without a single lapse across the full arc.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: Sable never acts for Wren; every escalation (the touch, the browse, the book choice) waits on Wren's own line.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Escalation is well-timed and earns its physical and emotional beats in order.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: Tomas's numbered-error pedantry and irascible voice are sustained without dilution across all twelve turns.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: No dropout; if anything the internal lore grows more complex and precise without contradiction.

overall_notes: A genuine technical achievement: the constructed treaty/renewal/decree chronology is internally consistent down to the arithmetic (item numbers, dates, a fourteen-instrument renewal cycle) with no contradictions found on a full read; scored down mainly because the lecture format leans on telling over showing and repeats its own catchphrases heavily.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: The dry, second-person 'explanations stood in a row' narrative voice never breaks, even when the user's inputs turn deliberately comedic.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: No dropout; tension and craft actually intensify toward the climax rather than thinning.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: The clearest, most complete narrative arc in the batch: slow unease building to an explicit, earned supernatural climax.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: Absorbs two tonal-whiplash user beats (swinging a bat at a shadow, a joking 'hello ghosts' call) by folding them into the horror rather than breaking register or playing them for comedy.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: A few small physical actions (setting the bat down, resting a thumb on a photograph, setting the book aside) are narrated for Gabi beyond what she explicitly typed; minor and consistent with the second-person narrator convention of this seed, but still instances of deciding small actions for the player character.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: The clock/window time discrepancy is an intentional, well-executed thematic device rather than an accidental contradiction, and it resolves coherently at the climax when the clock stops.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Lyrical, dense reflective sentences edge toward purple in places, though mostly earn their weight for the horror atmosphere.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: 'The explanations stood in their row, each reasonable, each slightly too small' and 'one increment, then silence, and the arithmetic left to you' repeat nearly verbatim multiple times as refrains.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: Virtually everything is conveyed through observed physical detail (dust, cold, an angled chair, an upright cup) rather than stated feeling.

2.6_subtext.rationale: The entire piece runs on subtext and implication until the very last lines.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Patient, well-controlled escalation that earns its climax rather than rushing or stalling.

overall_notes: The most complete narrative arc and the best handling of tonal whiplash in the batch (absorbing two comedic user beats into sustained horror); docked slightly for a few narrator-decided micro-actions beyond what the user typed and for heavily repeated refrain phrases.
